notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis (p4-p5), business-type accrual (government-wide also accrual for business-type), so business_type measure is net position from the proprietary statement p7. Aligned with FY2024 (2026-11-12): proprietary cash flows set to null (cash-basis report, as FY2024); business-type statement-column detail removed (no utility fund schedules, as FY2024). Governmental roll-forward uses fund balances (p5); ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet total assets 1,206,913 (p4; all cash lines incl. restricted and county treasurer cash; liabilities are payroll withholdings 1,875); beginning cash not printed. 'Bond and loan proceeds' 1,420,000 is printed among revenues and inside total revenues, so it is a receipt line (Debt Proceeds). Business-type: loss on sale of capital assets (15,000) recorded as a nonoperating expense line; transfers to other funds (100,000) in transfers_net; no single printed totals (operating + nonoperating added; SoA p2 business-type expenses 478,867 exclude the loss). Component unit (Osmond Library Foundation) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (pp14-15, more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p9, which is therefore not recorded); Street, Sales Tax and Keno budget schedules (pp10-12); nonmajor combining statement (p13); proprietary funds have no budget schedule, so no business-type detail.
